title: FarLandsMC
body:
FarLandsMC is a semi-vanilla survival server with a welcoming community and many features for more enjoyable gameplay!

A brief overview of some features:

### Core Features

- Discord server that integrates with ingame chat
- Playtime Based Ranks
- Homes
- Pocket World (for mining / resource gathering)
- Player Shops

### Quality of Life and Technical Features

- Bedrock Breaking
- Slime Chunk Finder
- Invisible Item Frames
- Infinite Dragon Eggs
